paragraphs.text: translated by
1. As 'twere the name of father, easy to invoke, we all assembled here invoke this Car of yours,
paragraphs.original: यो वां परिज्मा सुवृदश्विना रथो दोषामुषासो हव्यो हविष्मता ।
paragraphs.translit: yo vāṃ parijmā suvṛdaśvinā ratho doṣāmuṣāso havyo haviṣmatā |

paragraphs.text: Asvins, your swiftly-rolling circumambient Car which he who worships must invoke at eve and dawn.
paragraphs.original: शश्वत्तमासस्तमु वामिदं वयं पितुर्न नाम सुहवं हवामहे
paragraphs.translit: śaśvattamāsastamu vāmidaṃ vayaṃ piturna nāma suhavaṃ havāmahe

paragraphs.text: 2. Awake all pleasant strains and let the hymns flow forth: raise up abundant fulness: this is our desire.
paragraphs.original: चोदयतं सूनृताः पिन्वतं धिय उत्पुरंधीरीरयतं तदुश्मसि ।
paragraphs.translit: codayataṃ sūnṛtāḥ pinvataṃ dhiya utpuraṃdhīrīrayataṃ taduśmasi |

paragraphs.text: Asvins, bestow on us a glorious heritage, and give our princes treasure fair as Soma is.
paragraphs.original: यशसं भागं कृणुतं नो अश्विना सोमं न चारुं मघवत्सु नस्कृतम्
paragraphs.translit: yaśasaṃ bhāgaṃ kṛṇutaṃ no aśvinā somaṃ na cāruṃ maghavatsu naskṛtam

paragraphs.text: 3. Ye are the bliss of her who groweth old at home, and helpers of the slow although he linger last.
paragraphs.original: अमाजुरश्चिद्भवथो युवं भगोऽनाशोश्चिदवितारापमस्य चित् ।
paragraphs.translit: amājuraścidbhavatho yuvaṃ bhago'nāśościdavitārāpamasya cit |

paragraphs.text: Men call you too, Nasatyas, healers of the blind, the thin and feeble, and the man with broken bones.
paragraphs.original: अन्धस्य चिन्नासत्या कृशस्य चिद्युवामिदाहुर्भिषजा रुतस्य चित्
paragraphs.translit: andhasya cinnāsatyā kṛśasya cidyuvāmidāhurbhiṣajā rutasya cit

paragraphs.text: 4. Ye made Cyavana, weak and worn with length of days, young again, like a car, that he had power to move.
paragraphs.original: युवं च्यवानं सनयं यथा रथं पुनर्युवानं चरथाय तक्षथुः ।
paragraphs.translit: yuvaṃ cyavānaṃ sanayaṃ yathā rathaṃ punaryuvānaṃ carathāya takṣathuḥ |

paragraphs.text: Ye lifted up the son of Tugra from the floods. At our libations must all these your acts be praised.
paragraphs.original: निष्टौग्र्यमूहथुरद्भ्यस्परि विश्वेत्ता वां सवनेषु प्रवाच्या
paragraphs.translit: niṣṭaugryamūhathuradbhyaspari viśvettā vāṃ savaneṣu pravācyā

paragraphs.text: 5. We will declare among the folk your ancient deeds heroic; yea, ye were Physicians bringing health.
paragraphs.original: पुराणा वां वीर्या प्र ब्रवा जनेऽथो हासथुर्भिषजा मयोभुवा ।
paragraphs.translit: purāṇā vāṃ vīryā pra bravā jane'tho hāsathurbhiṣajā mayobhuvā |

paragraphs.text: You, you who must be lauded, will we bring for aid, so that this foe of ours, O Asvins, may believe.
paragraphs.original: ता वां नु नव्याववसे करामहेऽयं नासत्या श्रदरिर्यथा दधत्
paragraphs.translit: tā vāṃ nu navyāvavase karāmahe'yaṃ nāsatyā śradariryathā dadhat

paragraphs.text: 6. Listen to me, O Asvins; I have cried to you. Give me-your aid as sire and mother aid their son.
paragraphs.original: इयं वामह्वे शृणुतं मे अश्विना पुत्रायेव पितरा मह्यं शिक्षतम् ।
paragraphs.translit: iyaṃ vāmahve śṛṇutaṃ me aśvinā putrāyeva pitarā mahyaṃ śikṣatam |

paragraphs.text: Poor, without kin or friend or ties of blood am I. Save me before it be too late, from this my curse.
paragraphs.original: अनापिरज्ञा असजात्यामतिः पुरा तस्या अभिशस्तेरव स्पृतम्
paragraphs.translit: anāpirajñā asajātyāmatiḥ purā tasyā abhiśasterava spṛtam

paragraphs.text: 7. Ye, mounted on your chariot brought to Vimada the comely maid of Purumitra as a bride.
paragraphs.original: युवं रथेन विमदाय शुन्ध्युवं न्यूहथुः पुरुमित्रस्य योषणाम् ।
paragraphs.translit: yuvaṃ rathena vimadāya śundhyuvaṃ nyūhathuḥ purumitrasya yoṣaṇām |

paragraphs.text: Ye, came unto the calling of the weakling's dame, and granted noble offspring to the happy wife.
paragraphs.original: युवं हवं वध्रिमत्या अगच्छतं युवं सुषुतिं चक्रथुः पुरंधये
paragraphs.translit: yuvaṃ havaṃ vadhrimatyā agacchataṃ yuvaṃ suṣutiṃ cakrathuḥ puraṃdhaye

paragraphs.text: 8. Ye gave again the vigour of his youthful life to the sage Kali when old age was coming nigh.
paragraphs.original: युवं विप्रस्य जरणामुपेयुषः पुनः कलेरकृणुतं युवद्वयः ।
paragraphs.translit: yuvaṃ viprasya jaraṇāmupeyuṣaḥ punaḥ kalerakṛṇutaṃ yuvadvayaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Ye rescued Vandana and raised him from the pit, and in a moment gave Vispala power to move.
paragraphs.original: युवं वन्दनमृश्यदादुदूपथुर्युवं सद्यो विश्पलामेतवे कृथः
paragraphs.translit: yuvaṃ vandanamṛśyadādudūpathuryuvaṃ sadyo viśpalāmetave kṛthaḥ

paragraphs.text: 9. Ye Asvins Twain, endowed with manly strength, brought forth Reblia when hidden in the cave and well-nigh dead,
paragraphs.original: युवं ह रेभं वृषणा गुहा हितमुदैरयतं ममृवांसमश्विना ।
paragraphs.translit: yuvaṃ ha rebhaṃ vṛṣaṇā guhā hitamudairayataṃ mamṛvāṃsamaśvinā |

paragraphs.text: Freed Saptavadliri, and for Atri caused the pit heated with fire to be a pleasant resting-place.
paragraphs.original: युवमृबीसमुत तप्तमत्रय ओमन्वन्तं चक्रथुः सप्तवध्रये
paragraphs.translit: yuvamṛbīsamuta taptamatraya omanvantaṃ cakrathuḥ saptavadhraye

paragraphs.text: 10. On Pedu ye bestowed, Asvins, a courser white, mighty with nine-and-ninety varied gifts of strength,
paragraphs.original: युवं श्वेतं पेदवेऽश्विनाश्वं नवभिर्वाजैर्नवती च वाजिनम् ।
paragraphs.translit: yuvaṃ śvetaṃ pedave'śvināśvaṃ navabhirvājairnavatī ca vājinam |

paragraphs.text: A horse to be renowned, who bore his friend at speed, joy-giving, Bhaga-like to be invoked of men.
paragraphs.original: चर्कृत्यं ददथुर्द्रावयत्सखं भगं न नृभ्यो हव्यं मयोभुवम्
paragraphs.translit: carkṛtyaṃ dadathurdrāvayatsakhaṃ bhagaṃ na nṛbhyo havyaṃ mayobhuvam

paragraphs.text: 11. From no side, ye Two Kings whom none may check or stay, doth grief, distress, or danger come u on the man
paragraphs.original: न तं राजानावदिते कुतश्चन नांहो अश्नोति दुरितं नकिर्भयम् ।
paragraphs.translit: na taṃ rājānāvadite kutaścana nāṃho aśnoti duritaṃ nakirbhayam |

paragraphs.text: Whom, Asvins swift to hear, borne on your glowing path, ye with your Consort make the foremost in the race.
paragraphs.original: यमश्विना सुहवा रुद्रवर्तनी पुरोरथं कृणुथः पत्न्या सह
paragraphs.translit: yamaśvinā suhavā rudravartanī purorathaṃ kṛṇuthaḥ patnyā saha

paragraphs.text: 12. Come on that Chariot which the Rbhus wrought for you, the Chariot, Asvins, that is speedier than thought,
paragraphs.original: आ तेन यातं मनसो जवीयसा रथं यं वामृभवश्चक्रुरश्विना ।
paragraphs.translit: ā tena yātaṃ manaso javīyasā rathaṃ yaṃ vāmṛbhavaścakruraśvinā |

paragraphs.text: At harnessing whereof Heaven's Daughter springs to birth, and from Vivasvan come auspicious Night and Day.
paragraphs.original: यस्य योगे दुहिता जायते दिव उभे अहनी सुदिने विवस्वतः
paragraphs.translit: yasya yoge duhitā jāyate diva ubhe ahanī sudine vivasvataḥ

paragraphs.text: 13. Come, Conquerors of the sundered mountain, to our home, Asvins who made the cow stream milk for Sayu's sake,
paragraphs.original: ता वर्तिर्यातं जयुषा वि पर्वतमपिन्वतं शयवे धेनुमश्विना ।
paragraphs.translit: tā vartiryātaṃ jayuṣā vi parvatamapinvataṃ śayave dhenumaśvinā |

paragraphs.text: Ye who delivered even from the wolf's deep throat and set again at liberty the swallowed quail.
paragraphs.original: वृकस्य चिद्वर्तिकामन्तरास्याद्युवं शचीभिर्ग्रसिताममुञ्चतम्
paragraphs.translit: vṛkasya cidvartikāmantarāsyādyuvaṃ śacībhirgrasitāmamuñcatam

paragraphs.text: 14. We have prepared this laud for you, O Asvins, and, like the Bhrgus, as a car have framed it,
paragraphs.original: एतं वां स्तोममश्विनावकर्मातक्षाम भृगवो न रथम् ।
paragraphs.translit: etaṃ vāṃ stomamaśvināvakarmātakṣāma bhṛgavo na ratham |

paragraphs.text: Have decked it as a maid to meet the bridegroom, and brought it as a son, our stay for ever.
paragraphs.original: न्यमृक्षाम योषणां न मर्ये नित्यं न सूनुं तनयं दधानाः
paragraphs.translit: nyamṛkṣāma yoṣaṇāṃ na marye nityaṃ na sūnuṃ tanayaṃ dadhānāḥ
